description: OR-WIRE Decimal through ADO DDL with explicit precision: four tables DA DECIMAL(1,0), DB DECIMAL(5,2), DC DECIMAL(28,28), DE DECIMAL(28,0); SQL literal inserts including values at and past the declared precision and scale (rounding or refusal under dbFailOnError); then each table read by DAO Value and SQL CStr, and by ADO Value. Asks the stored words, scale and sign at the endpoints and which inserts are refused.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-wire probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
